products.title: Equity indices
products.intro: The S&P 500 is the broad US market, the Dow Jones tilts to large industrial and value companies, and the Nasdaq Composite tilts to technology and growth. Together they show appetite for risk and the phase of the equity cycle.
paragraphs: None of the 3 instruments holds above its 200-day average, so the primary trend is down.
The deepest drawdown from the 1-year high is Nasdaq Composite (-18.1%).
Over one month the Nasdaq lagged the Dow by 6.4 percentage points, so the market is favouring value and large industrial names.

rules.message: S&P 500 at least 10% below its 1-year high
Nasdaq Composite at least 15% below its 1-year high
Dow Jones at least 10% below its 1-year high
S&P 500 fell 2% or more in one session
Bitcoin at least 30% below its 1-year high
Bitcoin down 5% or more in one day
Ethereum at least 40% below its 1-year high
Gold up 5% or more over one month
Copper down 8% or more over one month
Silver down 4% or more in one session
EUR/USD up 3% or more over one month (USD weakening)
EUR/USD down 3% or more over one month (USD strengthening)
10Y Treasury yield up 50bp or more over one month
10Y Treasury yield down 50bp or more over one month
